project_type: TanStack Start (React 19 SSR + hydration) on nitro, single deployable artifact. Server functions in src/lib/api/* are the only write path; src/lib/server/* is server-only and reached exclusively via await import() from handler bodies.
language: TypeScript (strict), plus plain ESM .mjs for scripts/
build_system: Vite 8.3.2 + nitro 3 beta (nitro/vite plugin). QUIRKS: (1) vite.config.ts declares resolve.alias '@' -> ./src explicitly, NOT resolve.tsconfigPaths; vitest.config.ts repeats the same alias on purpose. (2) Vite inlines process.env.NODE_ENV at build time but all other process.env reads survive verbatim into .output/server (empirically confirmed: .output/server/_ssr/gemini-EgdzX_Ay.mjs lines 336/349 contain process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY?.trim()). contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md is the trust root and must never be edited. docs/logs.txt is APPEND-ONLY and now holds 61 entries after a union merge: append exactly ONE new entry at the very END in the AGENTS.md section 5.2 per-turn format (ISO-8601 timestamp with +05:30 offset, verbatim user prompt, agent response, agent response summary, commit SHA, every relative file path marked Created/Modified/Deleted, actions taken). Never rewrite, reorder or delete prior entries and never touch the two 'MERGE RECONCILIATION' seam notes. Commit only the files actually changed plus docs/logs.txt, staged BY NAME - never `git add -A`. Never stage .env, node_modules/, .output/, data/ or src/routeTree.gen.ts. Application source lives under src/. docs/APPROACH.md must be updated when an architecture decision is made.
key_patterns: ENV READS: src/lib/server/env.ts exports serverEnv(name): string | undefined - it tries the plain key, falls back to a BOM-prefixed '\uFEFF'+key, trims, and treats blank as absent. This exists because nitro parses .env with node:util.parseEnv which does NOT strip a UTF-8 BOM, so a BOM-saved .env renames the FIRST key to '\uFEFFNAME' and process.env.NAME silently reads undefined (this already broke GEMINI_API_KEY). DATABASE_URL is currently the ONLY key in .env, i.e. exactly the vulnerable first-key position. ALWAYS read it via serverEnv('DATABASE_URL'), never process.env.DATABASE_URL. Copy the usage pattern from src/lib/hubby/gemini.ts lines 15/63/86/89. Plain .mjs scripts cannot import that TS module, so they must mirror its exact semantics inline with a comment pointing at src/lib/server/env.ts. STORE: src/lib/server/db.ts is the single persistence boundary. db() is SYNCHRONOUS and hands out live mutable Maps; callers mutate rows in place (product.stock -= qty, order.status = ...) inside tx(), whose atomicity argument is 'Node is single-threaded so a synchronous block cannot be interleaved' - tx() throws if its callback returns a Promise. Mutations follow validate-then-mutate (all checks throw first, then writes cannot fail) because there is no rollback. persist() is sync fire-and-forget, debounced on queueMicrotask, and flushes via atomic write-then-rename. Money is ALWAYS integer paise. ERRORS: guarded() in src/lib/server/validate.ts is the only error boundary - only AppError messages escape to a client, everything else is console.error'd server-side and replaced with a generic sentence. Logs deliberately avoid absolute paths and raw errors. DTOs: every response is assembled field-by-field in src/lib/server/dto.ts so row internals (passwordHash, passwordSalt, userId, idempotencyKey, shopper street address) can never leak. AUTHZ: src/lib/server/guards.ts derives identity and ownership from the session, never from a request body; ownership failures answer notFound() not forbidden() so endpoints cannot be used to probe ids. STYLE: heavy explanatory file-header comments that state WHY and name rejected alternatives; zero-dependency hand-rolled code preferred over a library for small jobs (see src/lib/hubby/gemini.ts which uses plain fetch instead of the Google SDK).
directory_structure: src/lib/server/ = server-only core (db, seed, session, guards, dto, validate, password, pricing, ratelimit, env) - never reaches the browser. src/lib/api/ = TanStack Start server functions (auth, checkout, orders, vendor), the only write path; each handler opens with parallel await import() of the server modules then seedIfEmpty(). src/lib/hubby/ = pre-existing Gemini AI assistant. src/routes/ = 19 route modules + __root.tsx. src/components/ = mh/, ui/ (shadcn), auth/, onboarding/. src/test/ = vitest suites + setup.ts. scripts/ = plain ESM dev utilities (e2e.mjs harness, find-serverfn-ids.mjs, seroval-lite.mjs, cookie-check.mjs). data/ = gitignored JSON store. docs/ = APPROACH.md (architecture + ADR-001..ADR-009 + engineering journal), DOCUMENTATION.md, TECHNICAL_SECURITY_DOCUMENTATION.md, logs.txt. metadata/ = team.yaml, submission.yaml. deployment/ = README.md.
